Review round 1: LLM-Review -1 on change 1641, now addressed. Live change is 1646 (https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/1646); 1641 abandoned as superseded (amending lost the Change-Id, so the follow-up opened a new change rather than PS2).

The -1 was bugfix-size-attestation: 385 non-test lines, over the 150-line bug-fix floor, with no plan-review attestation on this ticket. Earning it surfaced three real defects — the gate paid for itself rather than being a formality:

1. BLOCKING (would have shipped a broken fix): the record file was never committed to the tickets branch. reconcile_helpers._commit_binding_store_snapshot stages only bindings.json, bindings-retired.json and get_rotation.json. Every reconcile pass runs in a FRESH CI checkout, so a record living only in the working tree is discarded between passes — the skip would never take effect in production and the bug would have outlived the fix with every unit test still green. Fixed: added git_adapter.IMPOSSIBLE_LINKS_FILE to the staged set AND to the per-file idempotency basename set (so a pass changing only this file is still committed), with a test pinning both.

2. BLOCKING (under-invalidation, cycle shape): check_would_create_cycle walks the TRANSITIVE dependency graph, so a cycle can be broken by unlinking an INTERMEDIATE ticket while both endpoints stay byte-identical. My endpoint-only digest would not have noticed, suppressing a now-possible link indefinitely. Fixed: cycle records key on the global structural projection. Over-invalidating costs one extra attempt; under-invalidating suppresses a legitimate link forever — the asymmetry decides it. The narrow shapes stay endpoint-local so they do not churn.

3. BLOCKING (under-invalidation, hierarchy redirect): add_dependency calls resolve_hierarchy_link FIRST, which can REDIRECT an endpoint to a type-tier ancestor; the validators then run against that promoted ticket. So the deciding status can belong to an ancestor, not the id passed in. Fixed: the endpoint fingerprint now covers every ticket on the parent chain (status + deps each), which catches the redirect target wherever the promotion lands without re-deriving the promotion rule and drifting from it.

Also took the useful advisories: re-qualified records are pruned rather than left to accumulate, and a corrupt store degrades to empty and still attempts the write (both tested).

Plan review now PASSES and the attestation is certified (currency basis: file_impact). Each new behavioural test was RED-verified by temporarily reverting its specific mechanism. 19 tests in the new file; 2402 reconciler tests green; make lint and make typecheck exit 0.
